ourStory.title: Bringing a British approach to dentistry in Egypt.
ourStory.paragraph1: Dr. Ayman Chhada and Dr. Essam Kayali began their dental education together at The British University in Egypt. What started there continued well beyond graduation, as both doctors kept building on that foundation through further clinical training.
ourStory.paragraph2: Their postgraduate path carried a distinctly British thread — including time studying in London, with Dr. Ayman completing a course at King's College London, and an implant fellowship delivered jointly with the Sheffield Implantology team through The British University in Egypt.
ourStory.paragraph3: Along the way, working in other clinics showed them where the patient experience could be more organised, more considered, and more complete — not only the treatment itself, but everything around it.
ourStory.paragraph4: The British Dental Hub was created to bring that approach home: modern, evidence-informed dentistry delivered with the comfort, safety, trust, and precision every patient deserves.
